create.name: Dr. Helena Soholm
create.bio:
Helena Soholm is a Korean shaman, or mudang, and a transpersonal psychologist based in Bellingham, Washington. Born in South Korea, she moved to the United States as a child and spent her twenties and thirties studying religion and psychology: a first degree at Smith College, theology at Harvard Divinity School, where she first met shamanism as a subject of study, existential-phenomenological psychology at Seattle University and a doctorate at Saybrook University under Stanley Krippner. In 2018 she finished that doctorate and, in the same year, was initiated into Muism, the indigenous spiritual tradition of Korea.

Her shamanic work centres on the ancestors. She leads ceremonies and rituals in the Korean tradition, often with drumming, music and dance, and offers long one-to-one sessions in person or by Zoom on ancestral connection, past lives and relationships. She teaches workshops on soul and ancestral initiation at Omega and in London, has taken groups to Korea and Denmark for her Illuminate retreats, and writes about decolonising spiritual practice so that people of every heritage can recover the ways of their forebears. Alongside this she keeps a psychotherapy practice for people on a spiritual path.

courses.title: Soul Initiation
courses.description: A residential workshop at Omega's Rhinebeck campus built around a full Korean shamanic ceremony for the ancestors, with drumming and dance. Participants also go on a guided shamanic journey to explore their soul's story and take home simple rituals for honouring their lineage.

courses.title: Korean Shamanism & Ancestral Ritual (London, UK)
courses.description: A one-day in-person workshop at the College of Psychic Studies in South Kensington introducing Muism, the shamanic religion of Korea. The day is shaped around an ancestral ceremony; bring a small family keepsake, a journal and a drum or rattle if you have one.

courses.title: Illuminate Retreat 2027 (South Korea)
courses.description: A five-day retreat in a traditional hanok village in North Jeolla Province, centred on an all-night shamanic ceremony under the full moon with two masters of Korean traditional music. Regional food and outings into the countryside are part of the stay; registration opens in early 2027.

courses.title: Ancestral Healing and Connection
courses.description: A three-hour one-to-one shamanic session, in person in Bellingham or by Zoom, focused on your family line and the gifts carried through it. It includes mentoring in recovering ancestral practices for people of any heritage; a short Zoom call comes first.
